dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, you said that graduates earn more. Is that true?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, juː ˈsɛd ðæt ˈɡrædʒuəts ˈɜːrn ˈmɔːr. ɪz ðæt ˈtruː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Well, it is often said that graduates earn more than people without a degree.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, ɪt ɪz ˈɔːfən ˈsɛd ðæt ˈɡrædʒuəts ˈɜːrn ˈmɔːr ðən ˈpiːpəl wɪˈðaʊt ə dɪˈɡriː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Many people. It is widely believed in Thailand, and according to research, it's generally true.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl. ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli bɪˈliːvd ɪn ˈtaɪlænd, ənd əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tə ˈriːsɜːrtʃ, ɪts ˈdʒɛnərəli ˈtruː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. But be careful. Don't assume that every graduate gets a good job.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. bʌt bi ˈkɛrfəl. ˈdoʊnt əˈsuːm ðæt ˈɛvri ˈɡrædʒuət ˈɡɛts ə ˈɡʊd ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's true. A friend of mine graduated two years ago, and she still hasn't found a good job.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtruː. ə ˈfrɛnd əv ˈmaɪn ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪd ˈtuː ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ, ənd ʃiː ˈstɪl ˈhæzənt ˈfaʊnd ə ˈɡʊd ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: In Thailand, is it believed that everyone should go to university?
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈtaɪlænd, ɪz ɪt bɪˈliːvd ðæt ˈɛvriwʌn ʃʊd ˈɡoʊ tə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Traditionally, yes. Thai parents want their children to get a degree. It's a strong belief.
dialogue.reading: trəˈdɪʃənəli, ˈjɛs. ˈtaɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈwɑːnt ðɛr ˈtʃɪldrən tə ˈɡɛt ə dɪˈɡriː. ɪts ə ˈstrɔːŋ bɪˈliːf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's similar in Canada. It is often said that a degree is the key to a good job.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈsɪmələr ɪn ˈkænədə. ɪt ɪz ˈɔːfən ˈsɛd ðæt ə dɪˈɡriː ɪz ðə ˈkiː tə ə ˈɡʊd ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But that belief is changing. Now many young people start their own businesses.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ðæt bɪˈliːf ɪz ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ. ˈnaʊ ˈmɛni ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl ˈstɑːrt ðɛr ˈoʊn ˈbɪznəsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting. You could use that in the debate.
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. juː kʊd ˈjuːz ðæt ɪn ðə dɪˈbeɪt.
